Subject: Supplier onboarding — request for DPA & SOC 2 link

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to move forward but procurement at Pegasus needs the following before we can accept Redwood into our vendor registry:

- Signed DPA (or DPA template we can countersign)
- Link to your latest SOC 2 type II (or a statement where we can verify)
- Current subprocessor list and processing locations
- PO instructions and billing remit details (who to invoice, PO reference format)

Can you share the DPA and SOC 2 URL? Our legal team will also need to confirm the subprocessor list matches our data residency requirements.

Thanks,

Ben / Lauren — can you confirm: a) whether Pegasus needs a signed DPA before PO issuance, b) preferred routing for vendor invoice (email vs procurement portal), and c) any tax forms we should expect (W-9, W-8BEN, etc.).

Hi Priya / Elena,

I can handle the PO/invoice routing. Quick answers: 
- Pegasus does not strictly require a countersigned DPA before issuing a PO in most cases, but Legal sometimes wants the DPA executed prior to payment for first-time suppliers — Lauren can confirm. 
- Preferred invoice receipt: procurement@redwood.ai (procurement portal is optional) — we’ll accept emailed invoices if they reference the PO.
- Tax forms: for US entities we ask for W-9; for non-US entities typically W-8BEN or local equivalent. If Pegasus is outside the US, please send your W-8 copy.

Action items for Elena: please attach the SOC 2 link, the signed DPA if you’ve signed, and your standard remit-to/invoice address. If you have a vendor portal entry request, include the company registration number and VAT/tax ID.

I’ll create the PO once we receive a supplier record and invoice.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: none]
